classification.rationale: The laundry hauler is a tote bag, a container of the kind covered by heading 4202, with an outer surface of plastic sheeting. Wheels and casters do not change its character as a tote/travel-type bag. CBP consistently places tote bags with an outer surface of plastic sheeting in 4202.92.4500 (e.g., HQ H278965, in force). It is therefore classified in 4202.92.45.00.
